releaseNotes:
Official Update v1.3.9:
- Automatic printer detection: lists every Windows printer, scans the LAN for network printers and adds them to Windows in one click (Options > Hardware).
- Kitchen display: Bump Bar numeric keypad support, custom cakes excluded from the hot kitchen, and a Kitchen KDS installer button on the kiosk page.
- DHCP auto-discovery launcher for kitchen and station installers (server and stations found automatically).
- Receipt printing: the Master prints through the server, secondary stations print locally (no duplicates).
- Chatbot and FAQ guides for Kitchen Display installation and printer detection.
- Database: added table name and last-updated columns to orders (safe migration).
